cases.name: Trudy Ann Hiler
cases.about: Worked at the Cal Neva Lodge at Crystal Bay, NV
cases.narrative: On 7/15/1971, he abducted her from a hotel employee parking lot near the Cal-Neva Lodge at Lake Tahoe where he had been lurking. On 7/17/1971, he "found" her nude body and reported it to the police. The responding officers noted that the victim was nude. He had strangled her, stabbed her 15 times and sexually assaulted her.
